'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Somali Civil War (2009–present)|Somali Civil War]]
**[[2022 Kismayo hotel attack]]
***Nine people are killed and over 40 others injured by an [[al-Shabaab (militant group)|al-Shabaab]] [[suicide attack|suicide]] [[car bomb]]ing and shooting attack at the Tawakal Hotel in [[Kismayo]], [[Jubaland]], [[Somalia]]. The three [[insurgent]] gunmen are killed during a [[gunfight]] with security forces. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/car-explosion-gunfire-hit-hotel-somalias-kismayu-port-city-police-say-2022-10-23/ (Reuters)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**Tamer al-Kilani, a founding member of the [[Lions' Den (militant group)|Lions' Den]] [[militant group]], is killed by a bomb planted on a motorcycle in [[Nablus]], [[West Bank]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/10/23/israel-kills-palestinian-top-member-of-armed-group-in-west-bank (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Insurgency in Paraguay]]
**Osvaldo Villalba, a leader of the [[Marxism–Leninism|Marxist–Leninist]] [[Paraguayan People's Army]] rebel group, is killed alongside two other militants during a gunfight with soldiers in [[Amambay Department|Amambay]], [[Paraguay]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-latin-america-63373068 (BBC)]
*[[Sudanese nomadic conflicts]]
**[[Sudanese conflict in South Kordofan and Blue Nile]]
***The death toll from the clashes over a [[land dispute]] between the [[Hausa people|Hausa]] and [[Berta people|Berta]] [[ethnic group]]s in [[Blue Nile (state)|Blue Nile]], [[Sudan]], increases to 220. It is one of the deadliest incidents of [[ethnic violence]] in the country during the last years. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/10/23/death-toll-in-sudan-tribal-clashes-rises-to-220 (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Jair Bolsonaro|Pro-Bolsonaro]] [[Brazil]]ian politician [[Roberto Jefferson]] wounds two federal policemen with [[rifle]]s and [[grenade]]s, who [[Siege#Police activity|besieged]] his house in an attempt to arrest him for violating terms of his [[house arrest]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/oct/24/brazil-politician-attacks-police-rifle-grenades-roberto-jefferson (''The Guardian'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2022 Irkutsk military aircraft crash]]
**A [[Sukhoi Su-30]] crashes into a [[residential building]] in [[Irkutsk]], [[Irkutsk Oblast]], [[Russia]]. Both pilots are killed. No casualties on the ground are reported, but the crash causes a [[power outage]] that affects more than 150 houses. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/russian-military-plane-crashes-into-residential-building-irkutsk-regional-2022-10-23/ (Reuters)] [https://meduza.io/news/2022/10/23/v-irkutske-voennyy-samolet-upal-na-dvuhetazhnyy-dom (Meduza)]
*[[Korean Air Flight 631]]
**A [[Korean Air]] [[Airbus A330-300]] overruns the runway of [[Mactan–Cebu International Airport]] after making two landing attempts during poor weather. No injuries are reported among the 173 occupants on board, but the [[fuselage]] sustains heavy damage and the airport was shut down. An investigation is already underway. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/korean-air-says-jet-overran-runway-philippines-no-injuries-reported-2022-10-23/ (Reuters)]
*A fire, spread by strong winds, occurs on the slopes of [[Tanzania]]'s [[Mount Kilimanjaro]].  [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2022/oct/23/firefighters-tackle-fire-mount-kilimanjaro-tanzania (''The Guardian'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Human rights in Australia]]
**The [[United Nations]] accuses Australia of breaching [[human rights in Australia|its human rights]] obligations after the state governments of [[New South Wales]] and [[Queensland]] refuse to allow UN inspectors into [[Detention (imprisonment)|detention facilities]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news/2022/oct/23/un-accuses-australia-of-clear-breach-of-human-rights-obligations-as-it-suspends-tour-of-detention-facilities (''The Guardian'')]
* [[Arshad Sharif]], a prominent [[Pakistanis|Pakistani]] journalist, is shot dead by police at a [[roadblock]] in [[Kajiado County]], [[Kenya]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-africa-63372440 (BBC News)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2022 Slovenian presidential election]]
**[[Slovenians]] head to the polls to elect their [[President of Slovenia|president]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/right-wing-politician-expected-take-lead-slovenias-presidential-election-2022-10-23/ (Reuters)]
*[[20th National Congress of the Chinese Communist Party]]
**[[Xi Jinping]] is re-elected as [[General Secretary of the Chinese Communist Party]] by the [[Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party|Central Committee]], beginning a third term as the [[paramount leader]] of [[China]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2022/10/23/xi-jinping-secures-historic-third-term-as-chinas-leader (Al Jazeera)]
*[[2021 Guinean coup d'état]]
**[[ECOWAS]] confirms that [[Guinea]]'s ruling [[Junta (governing body)|junta]] has agreed to restore civilian rule in two years. [https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20221023-guinea-junta-agrees-return-to-civilian-rule-in-two-years (France 24)]
*Thousands of people, including teachers and students, protest across [[Hungary]] against the [[Fifth Orbán Government|government]] of [[Viktor Orbán]], demanding higher salaries and the right to [[strike action|strike]] amid a high level of [[inflation]] in the country. [https://www.straitstimes.com/world/europe/thousands-protest-against-hungarian-pm-orbans-government-runaway-inflation (''Straits Times'')]
